description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing QUIC cryptographic handshake processes, including message creation, packet movement, and key comparison, primarily used in unit tests for QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: CryptoFramerVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that records handshake messages and errors during cryptographic framing.

classes.name: FullChloGenerator
classes.description: A helper class used to generate full Client Hello (CHLO) messages from rejected messages and inchoate CHLOs, used in testing QUIC handshake flows.

classes.name: TestProofSource
classes.description: A mock proof source providing test certificates for QUIC cryptographic proof verification.

classes.name: TestProofVerifier
classes.description: A mock proof verifier that validates test certificates and hostname for QUIC.

methods.name: HexChar
methods.description: Parses a hex character and outputs its numeric value.

methods.name: GetValidateClientHelloCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback for validating client hello messages.

methods.name: ValidateClientHelloDone
methods.description: Processes the result of client hello validation and extracts SCID and STK.

methods.name: GetProcessClientHelloCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback for processing client hello messages.

methods.name: ProcessClientHelloDone
methods.description: Completes processing of a client hello rejection message.

methods.name: CryptoServerConfigForTesting
methods.description: Creates a test instance of QuicCryptoServerConfig.

methods.name: HandshakeWithFakeServer
methods.description: Performs a simulated handshake between a client and a fake server for testing.

methods.name: HandshakeWithFakeClient
methods.description: Performs a simulated handshake between a server and a fake client for testing.

methods.name: SetupCryptoServerConfigForTest
methods.description: Configures a crypto server config for testing purposes.

methods.name: SendHandshakeMessageToStream
methods.description: Sends a handshake message to a crypto stream.

methods.name: CommunicateHandshakeMessages
methods.description: Simulates the exchange of handshake messages between client and server connections.

methods.name: CommunicateHandshakeMessagesUntil
methods.description: Exchanges handshake messages until specified conditions are met.

methods.name: AdvanceHandshake
methods.description: Advances the handshake process by processing packets between client and server.

methods.name: GetValueForTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific tag in a handshake message.

methods.name: LeafCertHashForTesting
methods.description: Generates a hash of a test certificate for testing purposes.

methods.name: FillInDummyReject
methods.description: Fills a CryptoHandshakeMessage with dummy rejection data.

methods.name: CompareCrypters
methods.description: Compares two crypters' keys and nonces for equality.

methods.name: CompareClientAndServerKeys
methods.description: Compares the cryptographic keys and secrets of client and server streams.

methods.name: ParseTag
methods.description: Parses a string into a QuicTag.

methods.name: CreateCHLO
methods.description: Creates a CryptoHandshakeMessage representing a CHLO with specified tags and values.

methods.name: MovePackets
methods.description: Moves packets from source to destination connection and processes stream and crypto frames.

methods.name: GenerateDefaultInchoateCHLO
methods.description: Generates a default inchoate CHLO message for testing.

methods.name: GenerateClientNonceHex
methods.description: Generates a client nonce in hex format for testing.

methods.name: GenerateClientPublicValuesHex
methods.description: Generates client public values in hex format for testing.

methods.name: GenerateFullCHLO
methods.description: Generates a full CHLO message from an inchoate CHLO for testing.
